desc: Paper notes: a note this device's notes.txt calls yours, but left from another address (another device, or this one on another network: the relay knows a note's author only by its address's hash), can't be taken back (TTYD_NOTES_PAGE, TTYD_NOTES_TEST 'o': no relay, the test answers with the relay's rules). On the page it is chosen twice: the answer is 'It can only be taken back from where it was left.', notes.txt keeps it (the address may come back), and Refresh still finds it, still yours
log_must: ^\[notes\] test: t0 at .* \(mine, left from another address\)$
^\[notes\] test: take gor_00 t0: It can only be taken back from where it was left\.$
^\[notes\] test: refresh: 2 notes in gor, 1 yours$
